title: Time-Series Forecasting · Direct Multi-Horizon Forecasting · Recursive/Autoregressive Forecasting
prompt: In **Time-Series Forecasting**, compare **Direct Multi-Horizon Forecasting** (training $H$ independent models for steps $t+1, \dots, t+H$), **Recursive/Autoregressive Forecasting** (feeding $\hat{y}_{t+1}$ back as input to predict $\hat{y}_{t+2}$), and **Seq2Seq / Joint Vector Forecasting**.
